scheme_name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
eligibility_text: Indian citizens with a benchmark disability (40% or more, certified) whose monthly family income is below the scheme's prescribed ceiling, and who need an assistive device (wheelchair, hearing aid, prosthetic limb, tricycle, etc.).
benefits: Free or subsidised assistive devices and aids, provided through ALIMCO or empanelled NGOs, on a sliding scale tied to family income.
source_note: Structurally stable scheme; income ceiling and device list are revised periodically — check disabilityaffairs.gov.in for current figures.
